# R86 — Exact persistent latest-source profiles under source-version edits

**Date:** 2026-11-12. **Evidence class:** author-side mathematical derivation and exact finite implementation checks. **Predecessor:** R85 source f951a675d30d66ffeb72b0080f396f54dfbd66e4. **Frozen S23/AV science:** 43ec6098b1330ae86d0a7863be336c5d97f6ef34, unchanged. This is an auxiliary rational circular-source model, not native X6/BRC dynamics, formal Task CLAIM, Result, independent Review or Foundation promotion.

## 1. Domain and all-real target

Fix rational closed I=[L,U], integer observer j, rational phase x and integer original-label coefficients a,b. Every source has distinct identity (t,branch), integer time t and totally ordered integer branch ID. Define source phase s_t(theta)={x+(t-j)theta}; original boundaries A(theta)={a theta}, B(theta)={b theta}. A source qualifies on the positive directed half-open circle arc [A,B), interpreted as ordinary [A,B) when A<B, [A,1) union [0,B) when A>B, and the **empty set** when A=B. This last convention is explicit, not implicit.

The answer is the lexicographic maximum qualifying (t,branch), or NONE. The requested whole-interval classification is STABLE_NONE, STABLE(t,branch), or CHANGES with two exact rational theta witnesses having different answers. Branch tie ordering is a stated auxiliary query convention.

## 2. A complete finite rational atomization

For each distinct source time t, form the set P_t comprising L,U and all solutions in I of these six integer-level boundary families:

1. a theta ∈ Z;
2. b theta ∈ Z;
3. (a-b) theta ∈ Z;
4. x+(t-j) theta ∈ Z;
5. x+(t-j-a) theta ∈ Z;
6. x+(t-j-b) theta ∈ Z.

When the coefficient of theta vanishes, that equation either holds identically or nowhere and contributes no isolated cut. Otherwise there are finitely many integer crossings in bounded I; all cuts are rational.

**Lemma 1 (complete atoms).** Membership of t is constant on each open interval between successive cuts of P_t. Membership at the cut points is computable directly from the original fractional-part and half-open-arc predicate.

**Proof.** Between cuts, each relevant affine expression has fixed integer part, the two original boundary fractional parts have fixed ordering, and the source fractional phase cannot cross either boundary without one of families 5 or 6. Floor changes belong to families 1,2,4; boundary coincidence belongs to family 3. Every defining sign predicate is therefore constant on an open atom. At a cut, the direct rational predicate handles closed/open endpoints and equality A=B. QED.

A complete Profile is the ordered rational cut set, exact winner value at each cut, and exact winner value on each open gap (evaluated at its rational midpoint, with soundness from Lemma 1). It encodes a function on **all real theta in I**, not a numerical sampling table.

## 3. Max-overlay and persistence theorem

Let W_S(theta) be the latest qualifying identity in any finite identity set S, with NONE below all sources. Then for any disjoint S,T and any real theta,

    W_(S∪T)(theta) = max(W_S(theta), W_T(theta)).    (R86-MAX)

This is pointwise associative, commutative and idempotent. To merge exact Profiles of S,T, take the union of their rational cuts. At every merged point and gap midpoint take the max of the two child values; the result is the exact union Profile by Lemma 1.

**Theorem 2 (persistent full winner).** Maintain a path-copied height-balanced binary search tree keyed by integer source time. At each node retain all branch identities at that time, its child roots, and the exact max-overlay of its own time Profile with its two child winner Profiles. After any sequence of insertions and deletions of individual (time,branch) identities, the new root represents the true latest qualifying identity for every real parameter in I. Earlier immutable roots continue to represent exactly their original source versions. A branch-only edit can reuse that time's membership cuts.

**Proof.** For an empty subtree the winner is NONE. A single time node's contribution is its lexicographically greatest current branch when its time qualifies, otherwise NONE. Inductively the left and right subtree Profiles are correct. R86-MAX and the exact overlay reconstruct their union with the node's own contribution. Path copying and AVL rotations reconstruct the affected nodes with their actual children, preserving the invariant and leaving all earlier immutable nodes untouched. Branch identities affect winner labels but not membership of a fixed time. QED.

**Corollary 3 (complete STABLE/CHANGES).** Inspect the root Profile's point and gap values. All NONE yields STABLE_NONE; all equal one identity yields STABLE(identity); otherwise any two differing atoms give a CHANGES certificate by selecting their exact rational point/midpoint parameters. No real parameter is omitted.

**Corollary 4 (version-independent per-time oracle).** With fixed signature sigma=(I,j,x,a,b,arc convention), each time t needs construction of its exact time-membership Profile at most once across arbitrary version edits. Branch changes, deletion and later reinsertion reuse it. Different signatures require separate cache keys or a separately proved transformation; retaining a stale cache without signature separation is unsound.

## 4. Complexity boundary

AVL edits create O(log(n+1)) structural nodes, but each rebuilt winner Profile has output-dependent cost: it can contain many rational breakpoints. The supplied code uses sorted set union and exact binary searches for each node's merge. Consequently **no logarithmic total update-time, bit-complexity or memory claim is made**. Coefficients with modest binary size may generate many explicit integer crossings. The profile method is an exact baseline for the complete STABLE/CHANGES obligation and a substrate for future compressed R71/R84 exclusion and R85 witness caching, not evidence of a universal performance improvement.

## 5. Reproducible executed evidence

Source checker: check_r86.py, Python standard-library Fraction only, no floats. Deterministic seed 8620261112. Main query I=[1/6,2/5], j=2, x=1/7, a=1,b=3, 72 identity edits and 16 historical-version audits. Additional 24 alternate rational query signatures include negative coefficients and degenerate arcs, 14 updates per signature. At every audited version, the program independently constructs all current critical cuts, enumerates their point/gap representatives, and compares persistent-root values to a fresh direct latest-source calculation; it also validates immutable AVL ordering and height, exact CHANGES witnesses and branch ties.

Actual local execution printed:

    R86_PASS 424 31070 240 1493

The run checked 424 complete version/tree states and 31,070 exact rational atoms; it constructed 240 time Profiles across signature-specific cache resets, allocated 1,493 path-copy nodes and merged 65,057 atoms. **All assertions passed.** These are finite author-side implementation checks, not a formal proof assistant result, asymptotic benchmark, or independent review. The general mathematical statement rests on Lemma 1 and the inductive invariant above.

## 6. Next frontier R87

Combine the persistent winner Profile with R71/R84 sufficient exclusion envelopes and R85 immutable per-time witness caching, so that most updates avoid explicit critical-stratum expansion. Test latest-source CHANGES certificates, dynamic maximum insertions/deletions, historical versions, branch ties and signature changes, including counterexamples to unsound reuse. Then compare actual CPU, integer-bit costs, retained nodes and output size against R83/R84 under identical all-real obligations. Preserve original source identities and frozen science; formal shared-task ownership must be separately authorized if that route is later selected.
